title: Dormant
summary: Manages the lifecycle of local project workspaces: clean, archive and restore a project without losing the repository behind it.
challenge: Free up a project's disk space without ever risking the repository behind it — every byte removed has to be confidently regenerable, and every restore has to be verifiable.
decisions: Classify before deleting: nothing goes unless it is confidently regenerable
Archive into ~/.dormant/store/ and verify the archive before the working copy is removed
Restore checks every file against the manifest checksums, then asks before running any install
A missing `code` command is a hard error, never a silent Finder fallback (D-015)
ownership: Designed and built the macOS workspace utility end to end.

callouts.text: Each local workspace, with the disk it is currently occupying.
